claim.quote: With a data acquisition live time of 0.338 kg-day at the Kuo-Sheng Laboratory, constraints on WIMPs in the galactic halo were derived. The limits improve over previous results on both the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon and the spin-dependent WIMP-neutron cross-sections for WIMP mass between 3-6 GeV.

key_value.note: Live-time exposure of the data set.
key_value.quote: live time of 0.338 kg-day at the Kuo-Sheng Laboratory

name: New limits on spin-independent and spin-dependent couplings of low-mass WIMP dark matter with a germanium detector at a threshold of 220 eV

summary.plain: TEXONO's first dark matter result: a tiny 20-gram germanium detector with a threshold of 220 electron-volts set limits for dark matter particles of 3 to 6 GeV, lighter than most experiments could probe.
summary.technical: Four-channel ultra-low-energy germanium detector, 5 g per channel, (220 +- 10) eV threshold at 50% efficiency; 0.338 kg d live time at Kuo-Sheng (30 m.w.e.); improved spin-independent and spin-dependent limits for 3-6 GeV/c^2; projections for full-scale experiments.

title: New limits on spin-independent and spin-dependent couplings of low-mass WIMP dark matter with a germanium detector at a threshold of 220 eV
why_it_matters: First sub-keV germanium WIMP search; it showed the technique later adopted by CDEX and CoGeNT-type point-contact detectors.
